statement: Linux's common output block has headphone level at offset 4 (documented 0..0x7f), speaker level at offset 5 (0..0xff) gated by valid_flag0 bit 5, and microphone level at offset 6 (0..0x40) gated by valid_flag0 bit 6. SDL gives those same three offsets field names, but its normal effects construction leaves them zero and does not exercise these validity flags. Headphone-level validity/behavior is not established by the cited kernel driver.

applicability.scope: Common-block offsets; USB full-report offsets add 1; BT full-report offsets add 3 for Linux or 2 for SDL; no real-device level acceptance inferred.
